en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhasayn Bin Ahmad, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I said to himasws, ‘Can I pray Salāt in the black cap?’ So heasws said: ‘You cannot pray Salāt in it, for it is an apparel of the people of the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 30. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhsin ibn Ahmad from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, if I can perform Salah (prayer) with a black cap. He (the Imam) said, ‘Do not perform Salah (prayer) with it; it is of the clothes of people of the fire.’”
